keywords.name: Adaptive Attack
keywords.description: This unit's Damage is always equal to its current Toughness.

keywords.name: Amphibious
keywords.description: Treat water as normal terrain.

keywords.name: Blast
keywords.description: Deal Damage to the primary target and each enemy within 1 hex of it. Attack Method — cannot combine with Cleave or Trample.

keywords.name: Charge
keywords.description: If this unit moved at least 2 spaces before attacking, increase its damage by 1.

keywords.name: Cleave
keywords.description: When attacking, this unit may divide its Damage among up to as many targets as its Damage value.

keywords.name: Defender
keywords.description: Cannot initiate Charge but gains +1 Toughness while defending.

keywords.name: Fear
keywords.description: Successful attacks apply Fear. While a unit has Fear, its attacks suffer −1 Hit. Ends at round refresh.

keywords.name: Fearless
keywords.description: This unit is immune to Fear.

keywords.name: Flanking
keywords.description: When attacking an enemy adjacent to another friendly unit, this attack gains +1 Hit.

keywords.name: Flying
keywords.description: Ignores terrain and friendly units while moving. May path across Wall hexes but cannot occupy them.

keywords.name: Formation Drill
keywords.description: Adjacent friendly units of this company with UV 3 or less gain +1 Hit on attacks.

keywords.name: Formation Guard
keywords.description: Adjacent friendly units of this company with UV 3 or less gain +1 Toughness while defending.

keywords.name: Formation March
keywords.description: Adjacent friendly units of this company with UV 3 or less gain +1 Move.

keywords.name: Frenzy
keywords.description: After destroying a unit, immediately gain one additional attack.

keywords.name: Guard
keywords.description: When an enemy leaves adjacency with this unit, it must take a Disengagement Strike from this unit.

keywords.name: Harden
keywords.description: Print as Harden X. Reduce incoming Damage by the sum of all Harden sources. Damage cannot be reduced below 1. Piercing ignores Harden.

keywords.name: Mounted
keywords.description: Trait keyword used for synergy. Has no inherent rules unless another card references it.

keywords.name: MultiStrike
keywords.description: Make X attacks against the same target. Roll separately for each attack.

keywords.name: Pack
keywords.description: While adjacent to at least two friendly units with Pack, this unit's melee attacks gain +1 Hit.

keywords.name: Petrified
keywords.description: This unit cannot Move, Attack, or use abilities while Petrified until an effect removes it.

keywords.name: Overpenetrate
keywords.description: When this unit's attack destroys the primary target, leftover Damage continues in a straight line behind them.

keywords.name: Piercing
keywords.description: Ignore Harden (printed Harden, Fortified hexes, Brace, and other Harden sources).

keywords.name: Poison
keywords.description: Successful attacks apply Poison. At the beginning of the poisoned unit's next activation, it loses 1 Toughness, then Poison ends.

keywords.name: Reach
keywords.description: This unit may attack Flying units.

keywords.name: Regenerate
keywords.description: Restore X Toughness. A unit may never exceed its starting Toughness.

keywords.name: Revenant
keywords.description: The first time this unit is destroyed each battle, return it once with half starting Toughness (rounded down, min 1).

keywords.name: Scout
keywords.description: May deploy one additional space beyond the normal deployment zone. May be up to 3 spaces outside Command Radius.

keywords.name: Shieldwall
keywords.description: While adjacent to another unit with Shieldwall, gain +1 Toughness.

keywords.name: Siege
keywords.description: This unit may Demolish Fortifications. +1 Damage vs units on a Fortified hex unless the card states a higher bonus.

keywords.name: Slow
keywords.description: On a successful attack, apply Slow. Reduce Movement by 1 during the next activation, then Slow ends.

keywords.name: Spellcaster
keywords.description: This unit may use magical abilities.

keywords.name: Stealth
keywords.description: Cannot be targeted by ranged attacks unless it attacked this round.

keywords.name: Harass
keywords.description: After this unit attacks, it may Move 1. That Move ignores Disengagement (including Guard).

keywords.name: Trample
keywords.description: When this unit destroys an adjacent enemy, retain remaining Damage, occupy the hex, and attack another adjacent enemy.

keywords.name: Unyielding
keywords.description: This unit cannot be moved by enemy effects.

keywords.name: Open Ground
keywords.description: While attacking from a Plains hex, this unit's attacks gain +1 Hit.

keywords.name: Woodwalker
keywords.description: While attacking from a Forest hex, this unit ignores the Forest Base ranged Hit Requirement penalty.

keywords.name: Bogstrider
keywords.description: While standing on a Swamp hex, this unit has Guard.

keywords.name: Duneborn
keywords.description: While attacking from a Desert hex, this unit's attacks gain +1 Hit.

keywords.name: Ashborn
keywords.description: While attacking from a Volcanic hex, this unit's attacks gain +1 Damage.

keywords.name: Mountainborn
keywords.description: While standing on a Mountains hex, increase this unit's Harden by 1.

keywords.name: Deepwalker
keywords.description: While standing on a Water hex (requires Amphibious or Flying), this unit gains +1 Move.
